# Forsa Design

> Forsa Design is an industrial web design studio based in Banff, Aberdeenshire. We build custom websites and bespoke web systems for offshore, energy, engineering, industrial equipment, logistics and manufacturing businesses across the UK and EU.

## Services

Custom industrial websites, B2B catalogues and ordering systems, client portals, API integrations and 3D product configurators. Visual identity covers logos, colours, typography and usage guidelines. Counterparty credibility and commercial risk assessment is a separate service. Ongoing support is optional and paid separately. Project times depend on functionality, content and integration requirements.

- [Dach Systema: 3D configurator](https://forsadesign.co.uk/en/case-studies/dachsystema/)

- [Counterparty assessment](https://forsadesign.co.uk/en/services/commercial-due-diligence/)

## Founder

Miro Potaczek founded Forsa Design after more than 20 years in international B2B industrial sales, working with metalworking machinery, engineering solutions and industrial equipment across Europe and Asia. He understands both sides of the procurement table and speaks English and Polish.
